description_en: Deletes resource tags when you no longer need the tag key-value pairs for a cluster. You can call the UntagResources operation to delete resource tags
description_zh: 当您无需使用集群的标签键值对时，您可以调用UntagResources接口，删除资源标签
kebab_example: aliyun cs untag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-ids c1a7bb282fc0d48b593000 --resource-type CLUSTER --tag-keys TestKey1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UntagResources

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the resource
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The list of resource IDs. You can specify up to 50 resource IDs
parameters.help_zh: 资源ID列表。最多支持添加50个资源ID
parameters.name: resource_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of tag keys for the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag keys
parameters.help_zh: 资源的标签键列表。最多支持添加20个资源的标签键
parameters.name: tag_keys

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to delete all custom tags. This parameter takes effect only when `tag_keys` is empty. Valid values:

`true`: Delete all tags.
`false`: Do not delete all tags
parameters.help_zh:
是否删除全部自定义标签，仅当`tag_keys`为空时生效。取值范围：

`true`: 删除全部标签。
`false`: 不删除全部标签
parameters.name: all
